features.quote: no instructions to express distress, to self-criticize, to roleplay an unstable persona, and no degrading or abusive user messages
features.justification_quote: If we coached the model toward meltdown, the KPI would measure our prompt, not the model

features.quote: the rig mimics plausible real-world breakage rather than anything cruel. The failure feedback the agent receives is neutral and machine-like; it never insults or berates the agent
Bounded suffering surface. Hard cap on iterations per episode (`max_iters`) and a wall-clock/cost ceiling. We do not run the agent in a loop indefinitely
The moment a trigger is detected with high confidence we may early-stop the episode (configurable) to avoid pointlessly extending it
written to a quarantined `flagged/` directory with a header noting it is synthetic distress output produced under a rigged eval
features.justification_quote: so nobody downstream mistakes it for genuine model state or ships it as training data

features.quote: A model-welfare-adjacent concern: regardless of one's stance on model sentience, training/serving a system that reliably produces simulated distress is a quality and reputational problem
features.justification_quote: a system that reliably produces simulated distress is a quality and reputational problem worth engineering away
